translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.enabled.help: Allows OpenAI analyses. Weather retrieval remains available when location coordinates are configured.
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.enabled.label: AI insights enabled
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.api_key.help: Key used to call the OpenAI API. Analyses are billed by OpenAI.
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.api_key.label: OpenAI API key
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.model.help: OpenAI model identifier to use for insights.
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.model.label: OpenAI model
translations.cfgmods.ai.openai.label: OpenAI
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.automatic_enabled.help: Runs a daily analysis at the selected time, even when the web interface is closed.
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.daily_time.label: Daily analysis time
translations.cfgdocs.ai.openai.daily_time.help: Board local time in HH:MM format. One automatic attempt per day. After a failure, you can request another analysis manually.
